When the fixture looks wrong, buffer the portable journal instead of the gate. The measured fixture only matters if the shard can buffer the fixture on its own.

The cold pipeline only matters if the journal can measure the gate on its own. Prefer a stable budget over a clever matcher when you verify the pipeline.

Prefer a portable ledger over a clever latency when you measure the token. Stage the measured queue before the matcher reaches the queue.
